📖 Explanation:

Italian driver Teo Fabi secured three pole positions during his Formula 1 career: at the 1985 German Grand Prix for Toleman, and at the Austrian and Italian Grands Prix in 1986 for Benetton.

Despite starting from the very front of the grid three times, a combination of poor starts, mechanical issues, and teammate overtakes prevented him from leading even a single official lap.

This makes Fabi the only driver in Formula 1 history to achieve multiple pole positions without ever leading a lap of a Grand Prix.
